thread:
kate: Heads-up — planning to onboard and pin orca-lite-4b v1.2 (quant) to the catalog tomorrow morning. Target window: 09:30–10:30 PT. Who can own the deploy and smoke run?

ravi: I can kick the deploy. I'll be on-call that window.

leo: I can run smoke tests + latency checks right after canary. Will run the short prompt set and the embeddings smoke.

kate: Perfect. Plan: 5% canary for 20m, 25% for 30m, then full swap if metrics look good. Rollback readiness: keep previous pin (orca-lite-4b-v1.1) hot, have autoscaler at normal.

jen: I'll monitor SLO metrics/dashboards and alert on any token-cost spike or error-rate drift. Add me to oncall for that hour.

ravi: PR for catalog change is up: https://git.internal/redwood/catalog/pull/4123 — modifies catalog entry and adds model metadata/quant profile. Needs one more review. @leo can you glance?

leo: Skimming now. A couple of nits on docs field, but nothing blocking. LGTM after small patch.

kate: Great. Smoke checklist (short):
- verify canary health (p50/p95 latency, 200s errors)
- run smoke prompts: quick chat, long context, batch embeddings (see commands)
- compare logits/regression score with v1.1 baseline

leo: Commands I'll run (local):
```
# generation smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted/models/orca-lite-4b/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"prompt":"Summarize: Redwood architecture in 2 lines","max_tokens":64}' | jq .

# embeddings smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood-hosted/models/orca-lite-4b/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":["test sentence 1","test sentence 2"]}' | jq .
```

ravi: Deploy steps (brief):
1) trigger catalog deploy job (ci/deploy-catalog) with pin -> v1.2
2) route 5% via runtime routing policy to new pin
3) wait 20m, collect metrics
4) if ok, promote to 25% for 30m, then full swap

kate: Rollback playbook (if anything):
- revert pin to previous version via the same job (ci/deploy-catalog revert)
- scale down canary routing immediately to 0%
- if traffic already swapped, pin back to v1.1 and trigger a quick full swap job
- postmortem stub in #postmortems if drift > threshold

jen: A few SLO thresholds to watch: error-rate > 0.5% (5m), p95 increase > 2x baseline, token cost > 1.3x baseline. I'll create an alert in console before the window.

ravi: infra-bot will post status updates when jobs run. catalog-bot will confirm registry update.

infra-bot: Deploy job queued: ci/deploy-catalog #4123 by ravi — ETA 09:30 PT.

catalog-bot: Catalog entry change detected for orca-lite-4b. New pin candidate: v1.2-quant.

leo: Quick note — I'll run a small QA harness that checks hallucination regression on our 50-check prompt set. Should finish within 10m of canary start.

kate: OK — final checklist: PR merged + green CI, ravi deploys at 09:30 PT, leo smoke/QA, jen monitors, rollback steps ready. Anyone object?

leo: no objections :thumbsup:

jen: all good from me.

ravi: I'll post start and completion messages. Thanks, team.

kate: Thanks — leaving this thread pinned to the deploy plan. If anything changes, update here.
